assumptions.note: Long-range planning model. Tax rules are a current-law proxy, not a forecast. House proceeds remain a future assumption until realized.

projection_inputs.etf_cost_basis_note: Planning proxy from prior FIRE projection; replace with broker tax-lot history before real withdrawals.

tax_rules.reference: 2025 IRPF scales + 2026 employee Social Security; used as a 2030 planning proxy
limitations: Does not model deductions, credits, joint filing, child allowances or future law changes.
ETF gains use a proportional cost-basis proxy rather than Spanish FIFO tax lots.
Pension eligibility at age 50/55/60 is a scenario assumption and remains subject to each scheme's legal access rules.
Baseline excludes State Pension; separate 0% / 50% / 100% current-law scenarios are modeled.

guardrails.protect_principal_rule: Above 3%, freeze inflation increases and reduce discretionary portfolio withdrawals until the draw rate returns to 3% or below.

cash_strategy.note: Compare keeping all house proceeds in cash with holding two years of the €30k real portfolio draw in cash and treating the remainder as investable.

monte_carlo.note: Simplified pre-tax sequence-of-returns stress test; State Pension excluded.

bridge_to_pension.methodology: Fund the inflation-adjusted lifestyle gap after net barista income from house cash first, then ETFs with the Spanish savings-tax proxy, until the first household pension becomes eligible.
bridge_to_pension.note: Pension balances are excluded from accessible bridge capital. Eligibility ages are planning scenarios and must be revalidated against each scheme's rules.

full_plan_monte_carlo.note: Runs the retirement cash/ETF/pension/tax waterfall with randomized annual returns. Uses the planning tax model and pension-rule assumptions below.

pension_rules.excess_distribution_reinvestment: Reinvest net amount into taxable ETF bucket in the planning model.
pension_rules.source_note: Current-law planning proxy based on Irish Revenue guidance. Revalidate before retirement/crystallisation.

contribution_source.note: Retirement projection reads the pension split from the FIRE contribution plan so accumulation and retirement use one source of truth.

state_pension.tax_treatment: Included as pension income in the existing Spain general-income tax proxy for scenario analysis.
state_pension.source: Ireland Department of Social Protection / Budget 2026
state_pension.note: Baseline remains unchanged with State Pension excluded. Scenario fractions are not entitlement estimates; actual entitlement depends on each person's PRSI/social-insurance record and future law.

actual_tracking.note: No retirement actuals exist before retirement starts. When annual actuals are added, the dashboard compares actual spend and end-of-year portfolio with the deterministic default plan.

lifestyle_spending_lab.note: What-if only. The official retirement baseline remains €60k/year in 2030 euros; scenario selections are browser-side and do not overwrite the plan.

model_meta.note: Decision-engine refactor. Dashboard version remains V2.3; existing functionality and official accumulation source-of-truth are preserved.

opening_balance_policy.live_source: latest FIRE balances projected to Dec 2029 with official contribution plan
opening_balance_policy.note: Official Plan remains the retirement baseline. Live Forecast is an alternative outlook and must not overwrite the official target path.

proxy.note: Fallback only. Future contributions are added at 100% basis in Live Forecast; replace with complete broker tax lots before real withdrawals. Raw broker lots should retain quantity, unit cost and fees before normalization.

Victor.note: Scenario ages are planning assumptions until each pension scheme's legal access rules are verified.

Rosely.note: Scenario ages are planning assumptions until each pension scheme's legal access rules are verified.

pension_eligibility.note: The annual engine uses the first full calendar year after the relevant birthday as a conservative timing convention.

asset_class_assumptions.note: Planning assumptions for mixed/bucket policy and Monte Carlo. The deterministic official baseline still uses assumptions.central_return_rate where explicitly selected.

three_bucket.note: €60k Pot 1, €60k Pot 2, remainder in Pot 3. Protected assets are consumed before forced equity sales; 60/40 is the central growth-bucket allocation.

stress_scenarios.note: Small deterministic set chosen to test materially different failure modes, not to forecast markets.

decision_analysis.note: All stochastic decision comparisons use identical market paths so the delta reflects the decision rather than Monte Carlo noise.
